The response repeatedly assigns spoken_by=unknown segments to specific besties (especially Sacks) as if they are confirmed quotes, which is a structural citation accuracy failure throughout.

Citation [7] is spoken_by=sacks but is attributed to Chamath in the dialogue, creating a direct speaker misattribution that undermines citation accuracy and voice authenticity.

The Druckenmiller reference is presented as Friedberg's own prior statement but has no citation support, and citations [11][12] are spoken_by=unknown yet confidently attributed to Chamath — both are attribution errors that undermine citation accuracy.
